reason: A DeepSeek Harness interface plugin that visualizes configured provider balances and usage quotas in draggable, resizable floating badges with periodic refresh and settings controls.

summaries.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 中以可拖动、可缩放的悬浮徽章显示多个 API 提供商的账户余额或使用配额。
summaries.en: Displays account balances or usage quotas for configured API providers in draggable, resizable floating badges within DeepSeek Harness.

capabilities: Fetches account balance and quota data from configured external API endpoints
Stores and uses provider credentials through the DeepSeek Harness credential store
Displays draggable, resizable floating badges and a settings interface
Refreshes provider data periodically and on user request
